title: Cobblemon Islands Server Modpack
description: Every Pokemon model, Megas, Z-Moves, raids, gyms, dens, and expeditions on one Cobblemon server. Install and the server is already in your multiplayer list.
body:
![Cobblemon Islands logo with Pikachu in a straw hat and a professor welcoming new trainers](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/674/597/cs1.png)

## Join the server in 3 steps

1. Install this pack with the Modrinth App or your launcher.
2. Press Play.
3. Open Multiplayer. The server is already in your list.

The address is play.cobblemonislands.com if you ever need it. Java Edition,
Minecraft 1.21.1.

## What's on the island

- Every Pokemon has a model, including Megas, Z-Moves, and Terastallization.
- Raids where the whole server fights one boss together.
- Player-run gyms and numbered ranked seasons with exclusive skin rewards.
- Mass outbreaks, Dens that drop rare crystal skins, and Bingo dailies.
- Expeditions: ride the train to other islands, each with its own biome and Pokemon.
- A seasonal battle pass: complete quests to level it up and claim rewards.
- Tournaments, catching contests, fishing, breeding with GTS trading, Safari, and a
  player economy.

![Exclusive Cobblemon Islands skins including Gladiator Chatot, Charizard Pikachu, Space Haunter, and Dragonite](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/674/594/cs7.png)

![Events and activities: Pokehunts, seasonal battle pass, ranked battles, breeding and GTS, fishing, gliders, catching contests, and tournaments](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/674/590/cs3.png)

## What's in the pack

Cobblemon 1.7.3 plus around 80 hand-picked mods: JourneyMap for the world map, Plasmo
Voice for proximity voice chat, EMI for recipes, and a full performance stack with
Sodium, Lithium, and Iris shader support. Everything comes preconfigured. Install
and play.

![Shader screenshots and custom Pokemon models from the Cobblemon Islands pack](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/674/602/cs5.png)

## Versions and requirements

Current release: Minecraft 1.21.1 on Fabric, Cobblemon 1.7.3. Allocate 4 GB of RAM in
your launcher settings. Older Forge 1.20.1 builds are legacy and cannot join the
current server.

## What's next

New content ships regularly. Customized PokeVillages, gyms, and Poke Prop Hunt are on
the way. The roadmap is public: https://connect.cobblemonislands.com/roadmap

![Rayquaza flying across the islands with a teaser for PokeVillages, gyms, and Poke Prop Hunt](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/674/595/cs8.png)

## Links and support

[Wiki](https://wiki.cobblemonislands.com) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/cobblemonislands) | [Website](https://connect.cobblemonislands.com)

Found a bug with the pack? Report it in the Discord support channel.

Follow this pack on Modrinth to get notified when we update.
